blocks.title: Electronic configuration
blocks.text: Kisi atom ya ion ke electrons available (maujood) shells, subshells ya orbitals mein kaise distribute (baante) gaye hain, isay electronic configuration kehte hain.

Subshells ki configuration likhne ke liye subshell symbols ek ke baad ek likhe jate hain, aur har symbol ke daen oopar chhota number (superscript) us subshell ke electrons batata hai. Maslan ⁹₄Be atom ke do electrons ‘1s’ mein aur do ‘2s’ mein hain, to us ki configuration 1s²2s² likhi jati hai.

Orbital diagram mein har subshell ke orbitals par us ka naam likha jata hai aur har electron ek arrow (teer) se dikhaya jata hai: s = +½ ho to arrow oopar (↑), s = −½ ho to neeche (↓). Boron (¹¹₅B) ka orbital diagram yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Boron ka orbital diagram: 11/5 B = 1s 2s 2px 2py 2pz; 1s aur 2s ke oopar ulte teeron ka joRa, 2px ke oopar ek oopar wala arrow, aur 2py aur 2pz ke oopar 0.
blocks.caption: Boron ka orbital diagram (kitab ke 2.7 mein bina caption wale diagram ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Boron ke 5 electrons: 1s mein do (↑↓), 2s mein do (↑↓) aur 2px mein ek (↑). 2py aur 2pz khaali hain, is liye un par 0 likha hai.

blocks.prompt: Nitrogen (Z = 7) ki subshell configuration likhein aur us ka orbital diagram batayein.
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen: 1s²2s²2p³. Orbital diagram mein 1s aur 2s mein ek ek pair (jora) ↑↓, aur 2px, 2py, 2pz teeno mein ek ek oopar wala arrow (↑).

answer_figure.alt: Nitrogen ka orbital diagram: 1s aur 2s box mein ek ek jora (ek arrow oopar, ek neeche), aur 2p ke teen boxes 2px, 2py, 2pz mein ek ek oopar wala arrow. Oopar configuration 1s² 2s² 2p³ likhi hai.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: nitrogen ki configuration 1s² 2s² 2p³ aur orbital (box) diagram
answer_figure.long_description: 1s aur 2s boxes mein do do electrons ulte spin ke saath (Pauli). 2p ke teen boxes mein teen electrons alag alag aur ek hi spin ke saath (Hund ka rule): is liye nitrogen ke teen unpaired electrons hain.

items: Electronic configuration = shells, subshells ya orbitals mein electrons ka distribution (baant).
Subshell notation: symbol + superscript (Be: 1s²2s²); orbital diagram: arrow ↑ (+½), ↓ (−½).
